dialogues.speaker: Kotimy
dialogues.text: I know! Don't worry, I've always been very serious when it comes to flight training!

dialogues.speaker: Kotimy
dialogues.text: However, having a good relationship with your Saurian is never a bad thing, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Kotimy
dialogues.text: Maybe soon I'll be able to help Ifa out, just like Ororon did!
